weaknesses.title: WAITMATCH is substring — ready matches notready
weaknesses.detail: Needle ready hits status=notready. Agents using short ready tokens get false handoff complete. No exact-line or HASFILELINE-style wait mode.
weaknesses.repro: WRITE status=notready; WAITMATCH path ready 0 → HIT=1

weaknesses.title: setenv then separate-run render loses ENV (process-local)
weaknesses.detail: Multi-tick setenv+render empties ${HOST}. Must pass host env on same process as SUBSTFILE. No plate-backed rehydrate in this board; same class as env_template W1.

weaknesses.title: HASHFILE is FNV-1a 32-bit not cryptographic
weaknesses.detail: Fine for change stamps; unsafe as integrity or auth. Name HASH/FINGERPRINT may overpromise to agents.

weaknesses.title: WRITEATOMIC still omits trailing NL on last line
weaknesses.detail: status plate host=peer1 without $; STAMP+VAL cat glue double hash display. Crash-safer rename does not fix NL hygiene.
weaknesses.repro: cat -A after WRITEATOMIC; STAMP VAL glue

weaknesses.title: WAITMATCH vs WAITFILE dual — existence vs content easy to mix
weaknesses.detail: WAITFILE empty TOUCH succeeds; WAITMATCH needs needle. Agents upgrading handoffs forget content predicate.
weaknesses.repro: TOUCH ready; WAITFILE hit; WAITMATCH status=ready miss

weaknesses.title: Empty CUBALC_ARG1 blocked as write needs body
weaknesses.detail: Cannot atomic-clear plate via empty ARG; language WRITEATOMIC "" works in-program. ARG/BLANK conflates empty payload with missing arg.
weaknesses.repro: CUBALC_ARG1= write → EXIT write needs body

weaknesses.title: SUBSTFILE soft-miss still writes empty expansions
weaknesses.detail: gone=end style; MISS counter only. Corrupt configs unless gate on SUBSTFILE_MISS.

workarounds: WAITMATCH needles with unique delimiters (status=ready\n or full line)
Pass CUBALC_* env on same process as SUBSTFILE/render
Treat HASH as change stamp only not crypto
